newsitem.title: UK: Japan sets up review of double hull tanker policy.
newsitem.headline: Japan sets up review of double hull tanker policy.

text.p: Japan's Transport Ministry on Tuesday formed a committee to discuss safety measures for large tankers in Tokyo Bay including a review of whether to promote the use of double hulled vessels, Jiji Press agency reported.
The move follows last week's oil spill in Tokyo Bay by the Diamond Grace. The report will include recommendations for other congested waters round Japan.

Issues to be discussed will include the promotion of a switch to double-hulled vessels, a review of how disaster prevention equipment is carried and used and measures to prevent accidents in crowded waters, transport ministry officials said.

The five member group, including the directors-general of the Maritime Safety Agency and the ministry's Transport Policy Bureau, plans to hammer out a final report before the end of the year, officials added. -Reuters Shipping News + 44 171 542 4087. Fax 5017.
